properties.statement: Every behavioral scenario has normalized, source-owned, discriminating independent positive and negative exact tests.
scenarios: Requirement and scenario coverage is complete
properties.oracle: Manifest rejection and accepted fixture graph.

properties.statement: Changed production and case dependencies select only the affected closure and loaded results become stale on dependency drift.
scenarios: Affected increment is applied or verified
properties.oracle: Selected case IDs and evidence fingerprints.

properties.statement: Typed observers require exact passing identities and reject missing, skipped, failed, planned or marker-only behavioral evidence.
properties.oracle: Per-case observed state and final report status.

properties.statement: Spec, scenario, source, command and dependency drift invalidate historical evidence.
Canonical execution tuples deduplicate while overlapping graph edges remain explicit and valid.
properties.oracle: Duplicate rejection and one execution record.

properties.statement: Protected or unavailable evidence remains blocked while authorized local evidence executes.
scenarios: Required evidence crosses an authority boundary

properties.statement: Execution policy, containment, process groups, complete artifacts and provenance are fail closed and reproducible.
scenarios: Verification execution is bounded and reproducible
properties.oracle: Exit, timeout, artifacts, selectors, fingerprints and Git state.

properties.statement: Only ADDED/MODIFIED behavioral requirements are graphed; purely historical deltas require no manifest.
properties.oracle: Parsed requirement keys and not_required status.

properties.statement: Path glob semantics and reverse indexes select exactly mapped owners and reject unmapped paths.
properties.oracle: Sorted property/case closure or explicit unmapped error.

properties.statement: Query exposes exact graph nodes and current or stale observed status, never suite-count substitutes.
Rendered routes and repository checks validate the graph and discovery ledger without claiming execution.
properties.oracle: Rendered contract and structural command presence.

properties.statement: Consumer routes query and execute a nonempty affected closure with exact intended and observed identities.
Final check executes the complete stabilized graph and cannot turn incomplete evidence into readiness.
Offline policy allows cached Go auto-selection and fails unavailable prerequisites without download.
scenarios: Consumer requires a newer Go toolchain

properties.statement: Explore records exact, semantic Context and capability-aware JetBrains-index lanes with classified results.
properties.oracle: Complete three-lane review or explicit capability reason.

properties.statement: Check requires selected property/test coverage and an explicit scope disposition.
properties.oracle: Covered identities and accepted disposition or deterministic rejection.
